를 구합니다. 선호 방향으로 늘어나거나 줄어든 만큼 보정 세기를 키우고,: . The correction strength increases according to stretch or compression along the preferred direction, and this multiplier is applied to the existing STC correction. The area constraint itself is unchanged.
절개 중심과의 거리 r에 따라 선형으로 줄어드는 가중치로 이방성 세기를: A weighting function that decreases linearly with distance r from the incision center controls anisotropic strength. It acts strongly only near the incision, avoiding excessive twisting of distant tissue.
기존 제공 ASTC 원고의 예비 결과입니다. 같은 절개 시나리오에서 방향: Preliminary results from the supplied ASTC manuscript. These compare the same incision scenario against ISO-Baseline (Extended-ISO), with the directional term removed, and are distinct from the published STC results. Incision shape and real-time performance were maintained while directional alignment and local response near the incision improved.
절개 방향에 따라 피부가 다르게 벌어지고 주름이 정렬되는 반응을 153: The model can show direction-dependent skin separation and wrinkle alignment in a real-time environment at around 153 FPS. It could support future training scenarios comparing responses to different incision directions. Clinical validity requires separate verification.
지금의 방향장은 절개 위치로 정한 모델이지만, 같은 자리에 실제 섬유 배: The current direction field is modeled from incision location. It could be extended to incorporate actual fiber orientations or measured skin tension directions as inputs. Separate validation is required.
삼각형 제약에 방향 가중을 곱하는 구조라 피부에 한정되지 않습니다. 방향: The method multiplies triangle constraints by directional weights and is not limited to skin. It could also be applied to surfaces with direction-dependent stretch, such as textiles or muscle.
기존 STC 계산에 가중항을 곱할 뿐이라 병렬 그룹핑 구조를 바꾸지 않고: It simply multiplies the existing STC calculation by a weighting term, so it integrates without changing the parallel grouping structure, with nearly unchanged processing time.
CT 영상 기반 변형 시뮬레이션을 위한 혼합형 프레임워크: HP-Chai: Hybrid framework for CT-based deformation simulation: HP-ChainMail and PBD active-block restricted solving
학위논문 저자 · 하이브리드 솔버 설계, 활성 블록 기반 제약 평가 및: Thesis author · Hybrid solver design, active-block constraint evaluation, GPU data structures and modular Qt experimental tools
동일 warm-start 조건의 전체 도메인 PBD 보정 대비 보정 단계: PBD correction stage speedup of 10.77× (Small) and 7.96× (Medium) versus full-domain correction under identical warm-start conditions. Hansung University master's thesis (2026).
변형을 빠르게 전파하고, 필요한 영역만 보정하다: Propagate deformation quickly and correct only the affected region
고해상도 CT 볼륨의 변형 시뮬레이션에서는 사용자 입력을 주변 조직으로: High-resolution CT volume deformation must balance rapid propagation of user input through nearby tissue with structural stability. I designed a hybrid framework combining fast ChainMail propagation with PBD constraint correction, evaluating only constraints connected to active regions rather than iterating over the entire domain.
ChainMail의 구조 제약 한계와 Pure PBD의 국소 입력 전파: I analyzed the limitations of ChainMail's structural constraints and pure PBD's local input propagation and iteration costs.
HP-ChainMail의 변형 결과를 PBD 초기 상태로 사용해 변형 전: I used the HP-ChainMail deformation result as the initial PBD state, separating deformation propagation from constraint correction.
전파 과정에서 기록한 활성 블록과 블록별 제약 참조 테이블을 이용해 보정: I restricted the correction scope using active blocks recorded during propagation and per-block constraint reference tables, preventing duplicate projections.
볼륨·변형·렌더링 모듈을 분리하고 Qt 인터페이스로 동일 입력에 대한 비: I separated volume, deformation and rendering modules and built a Qt interface for comparative experiments using identical inputs.

These are not overall frame rate or total simulation time improvements.
ChainMail이 모양을 먼저 잡고, PBD는 움직인 곳만 고칩니다: ChainMail predicts the shape; PBD corrects only affected regions
기여는 HP-ChainMail이나 PBD를 새로 정의한 데 있지 않습니다: The contribution is not a new definition of HP-ChainMail or PBD. Instead, HP-ChainMail is used as a structural predictor before PBD, and its outputs x
are reused as the initial PBD state and constraint evaluation scope.
이웃 요소의 상대 변위가 물성별 허용 범위를 벗어나면 그 범위 안으로 끌: When relative displacement between neighboring elements exceeds the material-specific allowable range, it is corrected into that range while deformation propagates. Starting PBD from the resulting x
에서 PBD를 시작하는 것을 warm-start, 변형 전 상태에서 시작: is called warm-start, in contrast to cold-start from the undeformed state.
반복 종료에는 정점 위치 변화량의 최댓값과 부피 제약 위반량의 개선율을: Termination uses the maximum vertex position change and the improvement rate of volume constraint violations. ChainMail predicts edge structure but does not guarantee tetrahedral volume, so termination checks whether volume improvement has stalled rather than distance improvement.
볼륨을 8³ 블록으로 나누고, ChainMail 전파가 실제로 지나간 블: The volume is divided into 8³ blocks, and blocks actually visited during ChainMail propagation are recorded as B
로 기록합니다. 원래 ChainMail에서 이 정보는 전파를 관리하는 용: . Original ChainMail uses this information to manage propagation; here it is reused to determine where PBD should apply corrections. After propagation, B
는 고정되고, PBD는 전체 도메인 대신 이 블록에 연결된 제약만 평가합: is fixed, and PBD evaluates only constraints connected to these blocks rather than the full domain.
학위논문 그림 4-1. 변형 전파에 따른 활성 블록 집합과 제한 보정 영: Thesis Figure 4-1. Active block set and restricted correction region after deformation propagation
BlockConstraintTable: 블록에서 제약을 바로 찾기: BlockConstraintTable: direct lookup from blocks to constraints
거리 제약은 edge의 두 정점, 부피 제약은 사면체의 네 정점이 속한: Distance constraints are registered in the blocks containing both edge vertices; volume constraints are registered in the blocks containing all four tetrahedral vertices. Using only one representative block could omit constraints crossing active-region boundaries.
초기화 때 CPU에서 한 번 만들어 제약 유형별 연속 배열과 블록별 시작: The CPU builds these once during initialization and uploads contiguous arrays by constraint type with per-block offsets and counts. Each iteration traverses only active-block ranges.
A constraint belonging to multiple blocks could be projected twice per iteration. Each constraint's integer flag is reset to zero every iteration; only the first thread to change it from zero to one using atomicCAS performs projection.

Volume, deformation and rendering responsibilities are separated, with Qt connecting interaction and result inspection. The following includes both the research architecture and later repository organization.

NeRF 볼륨과 PBD 모델 결합 · float4 RGBA 데이터 처리: Integrated NeRF volumes and PBD models, float4 RGBA handling, CUDA parallel resampling and rendering integration
스마트폰 영상으로 만든 256³ RGBA NeRF 볼륨을 64³ PBD로: Deformed a 256³ RGBA NeRF volume reconstructed from smartphone footage using 64³ PBD, visualizing it in real time through parallel resampling and ray casting. Published in the 2024 KCGS journal; Capstone Design Encouragement Award.
NeRF로 복원한 3D 데이터에 물리적 움직임을 더하다: Adding physical motion to NeRF-reconstructed 3D data
스마트폰으로 촬영한 영상에서 복원한 NeRF 볼륨을 PBD 물리엔진과 결: A four-person capstone project that combined a NeRF volume reconstructed from smartphone footage with a PBD physics engine for deformation and visualization. My responsibility was connecting the generated volume to the physics engine and rendering pipeline, rather than training the neural network itself.
NeRF 볼륨과 기존 물리엔진 연결: Connecting NeRF volumes to the existing physics engine
기존 단일 채널 볼륨 처리 구조를 분석하고, 색상과 밀도 정보를 함께 담: I analyzed the existing single-channel volume processing structure and extended the representation to handle RGBA volumes containing both color and density.
64³ 물리 격자의 변위 정보를 보간하여 256³ 볼륨의 변형에 반영하는: I implemented a resampling structure that interpolates displacement from the 64³ physics grid and applies it to the 256³ volume.
3D 텍스처 샘플링을 float4 기반으로 변경하고, 네 채널의 보간 결: I changed 3D texture sampling to float4 and implemented storage of all four interpolated channels in the output volume.
변형된 RGBA 볼륨을 렌더링 파이프라인에 전달해 물리 변형 결과를 화면: I connected the deformed RGBA volume to the rendering pipeline so that physical deformation results could be inspected on screen.
게재 논문 Figure 1. 팀 프로젝트 전체 알고리즘 흐름도: Published paper, Figure 1. Overall team project algorithm flow
서로 다른 데이터 표현과 해상도를 사용하는 NeRF, PBD, 볼륨 렌더: Integrated NeRF, PBD and volume rendering, which use different data representations and resolutions, into a single deformation pipeline.
병렬 리샘플링: 변형된 사면체 안을 다시 채우기: Parallel resampling: reconstructing the contents of deformed tetrahedra
물리 계산은 64³에서 하고 화면은 256³으로 그리기 때문에, 성긴 변: Physics is computed at 64³ while rendering uses 256³, so the high-resolution volume must be reconstructed from coarse deformation results. The volume is split into small tetrahedra and all tetrahedra are processed concurrently on the GPU.
256³ 볼륨의 인접한 8개 복셀을 하나의 셀로 묶어 255³개 육면체를: Eight adjacent voxels of the 256³ volume form each cell, yielding 255³ hexahedra; each cell is split into five tetrahedra. Regular decomposition allows direct calculation of all tetrahedral vertex coordinates.
PBD 결과의 이동 벡터를 보간해 각 사면체 꼭짓점이 얼마나 움직였는지: Interpolate PBD displacement vectors to determine the movement of each tetrahedral vertex.
변형된 사면체마다 축 정렬 경계 상자를 계산하고, 그 안의 복셀을 후보로: Compute an axis-aligned bounding box for each deformed tetrahedron and select the voxels within it as candidates.
무게중심 좌표로 원래 위치를 찾아 색과 밀도를 선형 보간합니다. 기존 방: Use barycentric coordinates to recover original positions and linearly interpolate color and density. Texture sampling was changed from the existing 16-bit single-channel format to float4 RGBA.
변형 사면체의 무게중심 좌표: Barycentric coordinates of the deformed tetrahedron
원래 볼륨 위치로 역매핑: Inverse mapping to the original volume
NeRF 밀도 τ를 불투명도로: Converting NeRF density τ to opacity
직접 구현한 부분: CUDA RGBA 텍스처 샘플링: My implementation: CUDA RGBA texture sampling
기존 단일 채널 볼륨과 달리 NeRF 볼륨은 색상 정보도 보존해야 합니다: Unlike conventional single-channel volumes, NeRF volumes must preserve color information. I modified CUDA 3D texture reads to return float4 values and store all four interpolated channels in the output grid.
아래는 데이터 흐름을 설명하기 위한 의사코드입니다. 실제 연구실 구현은: The following pseudocode illustrates data flow; actual laboratory implementation is not public. Sampling positions are computed in the original volume coordinates through interpolation of deformed tetrahedra.
원본 위치 ← 변형 사면체의 보간으로 계산\nRGBA ← 원본 볼륨을 삼:
Original position ← interpolate from the deformed tetrahedron
RGBA ← sample the original volume with trilinear interpolation
Output voxel ← store three color channels and opacity together
NeRF는 촬영이 집중된 중심부는 정확하지만 바깥으로 갈수록 노이즈와 먼: NeRF is accurate in the central region where capture is concentrated, but noise and dust-like low-density particles appear farther away. Voxels outside a central ellipsoid were zeroed, and densities below a threshold made fully transparent. Thresholds 5, 20 and 35 were compared; 20 best preserved shape and detail.

밀도 정규화와 렌더링 · 팀 전체 파이프라인: Density normalization and rendering · Team pipeline
NeRF의 밀도는 0에서 무한대 범위라 그대로 쓰면 색이 왜곡됩니다. α: NeRF density ranges from zero to infinity and distorts color if used directly. α = 1 − e
converts it to opacity in [0, 1] to better match actual colors.
렌더링은 광선 투사와 알파 블렌딩이며, 누적 불투명도가 0.99를 넘으면: Rendering uses ray casting and alpha blending, terminating rays early when accumulated opacity exceeds 0.99. GPU textures provide hardware interpolation, texture caching and automatic boundary checks.
512³ 볼륨(2GB)은 256³보다 변형 시간이 약 43배, 렌더링 시: A 512³ volume (2 GB) took about 43× longer to deform and 26× longer to render than 256³. We identified memory access as a bottleneck and chose 256³ (256 MB). The float4 representation uses eight times as much memory per voxel as the previous method, but halving each axis reduced the voxel count to one-eighth, preserving real-time performance.
볼륨을 GPU 텍스처로 한 번 더 복사하는 비용은 약 700GB/s 대역: Copying the volume into a GPU texture costs about 1 ms at roughly 700 GB/s bandwidth, outweighed by the benefits of many trilinear interpolations.
